name: Complete Admin Suite
author: wpplugged

sections.description:
Complete Admin Suite streamlines your WordPress admin experience with essential tools and customization options in one package. This modular plugin lets you enable only the features you need, with minimal performance impact and easy configuration.

Why Choose Complete Admin Suite?

Complete Admin Suite eliminates the need for multiple admin plugins by combining essential tools in one solution. Key benefits include:

  • Reduced Plugin Count: Simplify your WordPress management with a single, comprehensive tool
  • Consistent Interface: Unified design across all functionality
  • Performance Optimized: Minimal impact on your site’s speed
  • Regular Updates: Maintained for compatibility with the latest WordPress versions
  • Customizable Experience: Enable only what you need for a lean admin interface

Available Modules

Content Management

  • Post Duplicator: Clone any post or page with a single click, including all metadata, taxonomies, and custom fields. Perfect for creating templates or similar content quickly.
  • Gutenberg Disabler: Selectively disable the Gutenberg editor for specific post types while keeping it enabled for others. Ideal for sites that use classic editor for certain content types.
  • Body Class Customizer: Add custom CSS body classes to specific post types or individual posts, making it easier to style specific content with CSS.

Media Management

  • Attachment Replacer: Replace existing media files while maintaining the same URL and attachment ID. This prevents broken links when you need to update images or documents.
  • Media Filesize Column: Displays file sizes in the media library for better management and identification of large files that might impact page load times.
  • Media Bulk Downloader: Download multiple media files at once as a ZIP archive, saving time when you need to backup or transfer files.
  • Media Library Sorter (coming soon): Enhanced sorting options for your media library including file size and adding date.
  • Attachment Renamer (coming soon): Rename your media files directly from the WordPress admin without breaking links or losing attachment metadata.

Admin Interface

  • Admin Bar Customizer: Hide unnecessary items from the WordPress admin bar to create a cleaner, more focused workspace for your team.
  • Admin Logo Customizer (coming soon): Replace the WordPress logo in the admin bar with your own brand logo for a more personalized admin experience.
  • Admin Menu Customizer: Reorder and rename admin menu items to create a more intuitive navigation structure for your team.
  • Footer Customizer: Customize the admin footer text to add your company information, support links, or other useful resources for site administrators.
  • Heartbeat Customizer: Adjust the WordPress Heartbeat API interval to reduce server load and improve admin performance.
  • Notification Customizer (coming soon): Collect WordPress admin notices into a centralized panel for a cleaner interface and better notification management.
  • Recent Content Widget: Dashboard widget showing recently edited content across all post types, making it easier to return to work in progress.
  • User Activity Columns: Adds registration date and last login columns to the users list, helping you identify inactive accounts or new registrations at a glance.
  • ads.txt Editor: Edit your ads.txt file directly from the WordPress admin, making it easier to manage authorized digital sellers.
  • robots.txt Editor: Edit your robots.txt file directly from the WordPress admin, simplifying search engine crawl management.

Security & Maintenance

  • Login Logo Customizer: Replace the WordPress logo on the login page with your own brand logo to create a more professional and branded login experience.
  • Login URL Customizer: Change the URL of the login page for better security, reducing automated bot attacks targeting the default WordPress login page.
  • Admin Login Method Customizer: Restrict login to username only, email only, or both methods to enhance security and simplify the login process.
  • Maintenance Mode: Easily put your site in maintenance mode with a custom message or page, allowing you to perform updates or changes without affecting the user experience.
sections.installation:
There are two ways to install Complete Admin Suite on your WordPress site:

Method 1: Install from WordPress Plugin Repository

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Complete Admin Suite” in the search field
  4. Click “Install Now” next to the Complete Admin Suite plugin
  5. After installation completes, click “Activate Plugin”

Method 2: Manual Upload

  1. Download the plugin zip file from the official repository
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  4. Click the “Upload Plugin” button at the top of the page
  5. Select the downloaded zip file and click “Install Now”
  6. After installation completes, click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

Once activated, you can configure the plugin by:

  1. Going to Tools > Complete Admin Suite in your WordPress admin menu
  2. Browsing through the available modules and enabling those you need
  3. Configuring the specific settings for each enabled module
  4. Clicking “Save Changes” to apply your configuration
sections.faq:
Will this plugin slow down my website?

No, Complete Admin Suite is designed to only load the code needed for enabled modules, and it primarily affects the admin area, not your public-facing website.

Can I enable all modules at once or do I need to activate them individually?

You can enable any combination of modules based on your needs. Each module works independently, so you can activate only those features you actually need without any conflicts.

How do I get help if I encounter an issue?

If you encounter any issues or have questions about Complete Admin Suite, you can get help by creating a topic in the plugin’s support forum on WordPress.org.
